abstract: Mirror syndrome is a condition in which the mother "mirrors" her hydropic fetus and/or hydropic placenta. Physical and laboratory findings of mirror syndrome include generalized edema, hypertension, and proteinuria similar to preeclampsia. However, unlike preeclampsia, mirror syndrome is associated with hemodilutional anemia and fluid overload, which may progress to pulmonary edema. The anesthetic management of a parturient with fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma, hydrops fetalis, and mirror syndrome complicated by markedly elevated maternal serum human chorionic gonadotropin and subsequent clinical hyperthyroidism, is presented.
abstract_ja: ミラー症候群とは、母体が水腫状の胎児や水腫状の胎盤を「映し出す」状態を指す。ミラー症候群の身体所見および検査所見には、全身浮腫、高血圧、蛋白尿があり、子癇前症に類似する。しかし子癇前症と異なり、ミラー症候群では血液希釈性貧血と体液過剰を伴い、肺水腫へ進行しうる。胎児仙尾部奇形腫、胎児水腫およびミラー症候群を有する妊婦の麻酔管理を提示する。母体血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が著明に上昇し、その後臨床的な甲状腺機能亢進症を来した。
